tensura.skill.wind.description:
Wind burst at your feet pushes creatures away and can launch you upward.
*Hold 1s (0.05s mastered), release*.
tensura.skill.wind_blade.description:
Fires a wind blade: 20 damage with heavy knockback.
*Hold 2s (1s mastered), release*.
tensura.skill.summon_basilisk.descriptio:
Summons a tame Basilisk to fight for you. Costs 500 magicule, then 100/s.
*Hold 5s (3s mastered), release*.
*Sneak+press* at your summon within 30 blocks: dismiss.
tensura.skill.summon_daemon.description:
Calls a daemon; costs twice its EP, reduced by nearby sacrifices. Strong daemons may attack you.
*Hold 15s, release*.
[Lesser Daemon]/[Greater Daemon]: choose rank.
[Arch Daemon]: mastered rank.
[Random Daemon]: random rank.
tensura.skill.summon_hound_dog.descripti:
Summons a tame evolved Hound Dog to fight for you. Costs 50 magicule, then 10/s.
*Hold 5s (3s mastered), release*.
*Sneak+press* at your summon within 30 blocks: dismiss.
tensura.skill.summon_otherworlder.descri:
Summons an otherworlder for 3,000,000 magicule; may arrive as a baby.
*Hold* aiming within 8 blocks: make and charge a circle, 50,000 every 3s (100,000 mastered). Keep holding at the full circle to finish.
mysticism.skill.butcher.description:
{P}: physical hits build marks; 10 marks cause Rupturing.
[Heighten] *press*: toggle ×2 movement/attack speed.
[Rupture] *press*: pick a foe with 15+ marks.
[血淋林的爱] *press*: butchering menu for your last hit target; needs a charge from a marked kill.
mysticism.skill.captivator.description:
Charms creatures and buffs followers within 20 blocks.
[Performance] *hold*: charm/inspire; release switches Truth/Lie.
[Masquerade] *press*: heal/buff allies, blind foes for 10s.
[Unveil] *press*: paralyse for 10s; mastered adds Marked for Death.
[Star Power] *press*: Dazzled for 10s on foes looking at you (mastered).
mysticism.skill.coalescence.description:
Freezes foes in place and raises shields.
[Fixation] *press*: target within 10 blocks for 10s (15 blocks, 20s mastered).
[Solidification] *press*: shield for 20s (40 mastered); *sneak+press* at it to remove.
[Eternal Domain] *press*: Fixation field for 20s (40 mastered), 10,000 magicule.
*Toggle*: block Slowness/Burden.
mysticism.skill.constant.description:
Locks health or attack damage.
[Constant: Health] *hold*: restore health after hits, up to 15s; 1,000 magicule/s.
[Constant: Physical] *press*: record strongest hit over 5s.
[Constant: Destruction] *hold*: recorded damage (cap 5,000), up to 10s; 3,000 magicule/s.
[Constant: Energy] *press*: defer costs for 10s, repay ×2 (mastered).
mysticism.skill.corroder.description:
{P}: toggle to coat physical hits in Corrosion II for 10s (III, 15s mastered).
[Dissolve] *hold*: 10 damage every 0.5s within 10 blocks (15 damage/blocks mastered), plus Corrosion.
[Cross Corrosion] *press*: toggle ×2 corrosion damage on sword hits.
mysticism.skill.crasher.description:
Void aura damages foes within 15 blocks: 25/s (50 mastered); weaker foes are slowed. May give YOU Insanity.
[Destroyer Haki] *hold*: aura on.
[Dimension Hopper] *scroll*: choose dimension; *hold, release*: travel.
*Toggle*: Thought Acceleration.
mysticism.skill.cultivator.description:
{P}: empty-handed physical hits deal +50 damage (+100 mastered).
*Toggle*: more magicule gained.
[Breakthrough] *press* after 1,000 mob kills: cultivate for 300s. Dying during cultivation resets progress. Cooldown 180s.
mysticism.skill.dreamer.description:
Saves your health, energy and position; restores them on return or death.
[Dream] *press*: save (25% max magicule)/return; *sneak+press*: cancel save.
[Hypnosis] *hold*: Drowsiness within 10 blocks (15 mastered).
[Dream Eater] *hold 5s* at a drowsy foe: 30 damage +30 spiritual (50+50 mastered).
mysticism.skill.engineer.description:
Builds a shooting sentry or a food/energy dispenser for 500 magicule.
[Build] *scroll*: choose building; *hold 5s* at solid ground.
[Bubble Shield] *press* on solid ground: barrier for 15s (30 mastered).
mysticism.skill.gardener.description:
*Toggle*: speeds crop growth within 10 blocks; costs 100 magicule per growth check.
[Blessing] *press* holding food: adds Strengthen at dawn, Resistance at noon, Speed at night when eaten.
[Overgrow] *press*: no growth boost found.
[Entwine] *press*: selects foes only; no effect found.
mysticism.skill.gatekeeper.description:
Binds foes and fires stored weapons through gates.
[Enkidu] *press*: bind target within 10 blocks for 120s (240 mastered); press again to free. 25,000 magicule.
[Kings Storehouse] *press*: weapon storage.
[Gate Of Babylon] *hold*: fire; 25,000 magicule/s.
*Sneak+press*: Direct Fire/Surround Attack.
mysticism.skill.hidden_ruler.description:
Copies Common, Extra or Intrinsic skills; duplicates enter a bank.
[Copy] *press*: copy; *sneak+press*: view bank.
[Paste] *press*: give banked skill; *sneak+press*: select.
[Clear Bank] *press*, then *sneak+press* within 3s: erase bank.
[Darkness Conscription] *press*: charm; both light levels below 5.
*Toggle*: conceal presence.
mysticism.skill.jinchuriki.description:
Charged bomb: 6 damage × power; above ×3 adds a 150-damage blast.
[Tailed Beast Bomb] *hold, release*: charge/fire; minimum 1s (0.5 mastered). Each ×1 costs 800 magicule +200 aura.
[Tailed Beast Cloak] *press*: berserk clone until 250 uses, then controllable cloak.
*Sneak+press*: check uses/state.
mysticism.skill.kyurem.description:
Freezing attacks slow foes.
[Glaciate] *hold*: damage within 15 blocks rises to 100 (200 mastered).
[Draconic Pulse] *press*: 40-damage shot, 7.5-block blast.
[Freeze Dry] *hold* at a foe within 5 blocks: 20 damage.
[Blizzard] *hold*: 7.5-block storm, 40 damage plus Chill.
mysticism.skill.malleable.description:
Defensive healing and a clay body.
[Alchemy] *press*: active for 10s (toggle mastered); effect not found. *Sneak+hold*: check element; *sneak+scroll*: select.
[Harden] *hold*: Regen V, Resistance II, +10 armor for up to 10s (15 mastered); cannot move/attack.
[Vessel] *press*: inert Clay Golem, 50 HP (200 mastered).
mysticism.skill.melancholy.description:
*Toggle*: aura slows nearby creatures and you; gives you Resistance II.
[Gust] *press*: push target; *sneak+press*: pull. No target: throw held item or air (75 damage, 100 mastered).
[Turbulent Force] *hold*: move target.
[Grief] *press*: shove within 8 blocks, Blindness/Weakness for 10s.
*Scroll*: range, 3–15 blocks (50 mastered).
mysticism.skill.phaser.description:
Dodges hits with 5s intangibility; overuse limits it.
[Eject] *hold 3s (1.5 mastered), release*: fire stored items; *sneak+press*: storage.
[Authority Of The Gods] *sneak+hold 3s (1.5 mastered), release*: enter/leave Kamui; without sneak, warp a foe (mastered).
[Intangibility] *press*: phase (mastered).
[Intangibility: Toggle] *press*: auto-dodge on/off (mastered).
mysticism.skill.provider.description:
Halo boosts other creatures and their projectiles; builds Contributions.
[Generosity] *press*: summon halo, 1,000 magicule +500/s; others' shots deal ×3 damage.
[Pay It Forward] *press*: 1,000+ Contributions grant speed, step height and ×1.5–5 damage; 1,500 magicule +750/s.
*Sneak+press*: end halo/buff in its mode.
